name: Menicon Co., Ltd.
summary: Menicon Co., Ltd. produces and sells contact lenses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Vision Care Business and Others segments. The company offers disposable lenses, MTO specialty lenses, myopia management products, and lens care products.
